alert_news.title: IIT Kharagpur commits ₹35 crore to establish dedicated School of Physical AI
bullets: India's first dedicated academic school for Physical AI, to be set up at IIT Kharagpur
Funded with ₹35 crore – ₹12.5 crore from Vinod Gupta family, ₹10 crore from an anonymous alumnus, and ₹12.5 crore from IIT Kharagpur
School named Benjamin Gupta School of Physical AI, focusing on AI integrated with physics, engineering, biology and medical sciences

alert_news.title: India’s First Underwater Museum – INS Guldar Project
bullets: India’s first underwater museum, artificial reef and submarine tourism destination at INS Guldar, Sindhudurg, Maharashtra, built by Maharashtra Tourism Development Corporation (MTDC).
Project promotes sustainable marine tourism and conservation by creating a marine heritage site.

alert_news.title: India’s First Underwater Museum, Artificial Reef and Submarine Tourism Destination at INS Guldar
bullets: India’s first underwater museum, artificial reef, and submarine tourism destination at INS Guldar, Sindhudurg district, Maharashtra, developed by Maharashtra Tourism Development Corporation (MTDC).
Project aims to create a marine heritage site to attract divers and tourists, marking a pioneering step in underwater tourism infrastructure.

alert_news.title: IIT Kharagpur To Set Up India's First Physical AI School With Focus On Robotics ...
bullets: India’s first dedicated academic school for Physical Artificial Intelligence, the Benjamin Gupta School of Physical AI, will be established at IIT Kharagpur.
The project is funded with a total investment of ₹35 crore, contributed by the Vinod Gupta family (₹12.5 crore), an anonymous alumnus (₹10 crore), and IIT Kharagpur.

alert_news.title: IIT Kharagpur Announces India's First School for Physical AI - Check Courses, Curriculum Details
bullets: IIT Kharagpur will launch India’s first dedicated academic school for Physical Artificial Intelligence, the Benjamin Gupta School of Physical AI.
The school will be funded with ₹35 crore, comprising ₹12.5 crore from the Vinod Gupta family, ₹10 crore from an anonymous alumnus, and the rest from IIT Kharagpur.

alert_news.title: Bengaluru's Rs 6,000 Crore Elevated Railway Terminal Likely To Get DPR From Aarvee Associates
bullets: India’s first fully elevated railway coaching terminal at Yelahanka, Bengaluru, to be built by South Western Railway (SWR).
Estimated cost Rs 6,000 crore, covering 20 acres, with 16 platforms, replacing the existing 5‑platform Yelahanka station.

alert_news.title: Maharashtra becomes first state to deploy eight drug quality detector machines - Mid-Day
bullets: Maharashtra becomes first state in India to deploy drug quality detector machines, installing eight units across its regions.
Each machine costs Rs 1.2 crore, enabling on‑site testing of government‑procured medicines and flagging adulterated samples for NABL.
